notes: Original outputs preserved at their returned dimensions. Reference assets share architecture and palette; no raster post-processing.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production exploration-map background for Hearth Town, a tiny original starter town in the custom Pokémon region Hearthvale.
Primary request: one polished, cohesive, richly readable GBA-era Pokémon overworld pixel-art town map, inspired by the intimate simplicity of Pallet Town but with a new original layout. Full canvas landscape 1536 by 1024 pixels, north at top. Flat orthographic top-down with classic RPG roofs and small south-facing building fronts. Uniform deliberately chunky crisp pixel clusters, limited shades, no blur, no painterly rendering.
Scene: a very small peaceful grassland town, only FOUR buildings, spacious open lawns, warm cream paths and low wooden fences, round leafy trees around the perimeter, tiny white/yellow flowers, two separate tall-grass encounter clearings. Bright gentle daytime, sage and spring greens, deep blue-green tree shadows, warm terracotta red roofs, one desaturated teal lab roof. Original custom region, cozy and understated.
Composition and clickable landmark layout: 
- North exit at precisely the middle of the top edge, a cream dirt path passing through trees and entering town; a small blank wooden sign near x=52%, y=17%.
- Player cottage centered x=26%, y=36%, little cream walls, terracotta roof, one chimney, flower garden and short fence; footprint approximately x18–34%, y24–44%.
- Pokémon Center centered x=72%, y=35%, compact cream building, red roof and a tiny red-and-white circular Poké Ball symbol above doorway; no lettering; footprint x63–82%, y23–45%.
- Town green at x=49%, y=53%, a modest roundish dusty clearing with a single small square stone well and one wooden bench, joined by broad simple footpaths.
- A second tiny cottage centered x=25%, y=74%, terracotta roof; footprint x18–33%, y63–82%.
- Professor's modest lab centered x=70%, y=74%, slightly wider cream building, muted teal roof, small garden; footprint x59–82%, y61–84%.
- Western tall-grass habitat x5–15%, y46–69%, an airy grass clearing next to trees and a fallen log.
- Eastern meadow tall-grass habitat x85–95%, y49–73%, wildflowers, low fence.
Paths link all four doors to the town green and the north exit. Keep a clearly distinct walkable grass/path area around each doorway. Trees form the bottom border; no south exit. No pond, ocean, cliff, mountain, bridge, skyscraper or extra buildings.
Environment art only: Pokémon and trainers will be independent runtime sprites; do not draw any people or creatures into this background. Grass habitats should feel suitable for Pidgey, Rattata, Sentret and small bug Pokémon.
No words, no text, no labels, no baked-in UI, no map pins, no selection circles, no arrows, no grid, no frame, no title, no legend, no watermark. Fill the full rectangular canvas with terrain, no transparent margins. The map must read instantly as a tiny friendly first town, not a city.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent Hearth Town avatar for a Pokémon game destination-selection menu.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND ARCHITECTURE REFERENCE of Hearth Town, not an edit target. Create a new separate icon. Match its cream walls, terracotta-red tiled cottage roofs, teal professor lab roof, round green trees, warm paths and cozy GBA pixel-art treatment.
Primary request: a compact friendly pixel-art miniature of this tiny town, an instantly recognizable town avatar on a truly transparent RGBA background. Square 1024x1024 canvas. Large simple chunky pixel clusters; make the silhouette readable at 96 to 128 CSS pixels. This is ONE icon only, not a sheet.
Composition: a small rounded grassy ground patch viewed from the same high top-down RPG perspective, no floating rock base. In the patch a prominent little red-roofed cream cottage with chimney in foreground-left, a modest teal-roofed lab behind/right, a smaller red-roofed Pokémon Center behind/left with tiny red-white ball emblem. One simple sand path, a tiny stone well, two rounded leafy trees framing the buildings, and a few tall-grass tufts and yellow flowers. Warm welcoming quiet hometown, lush spring green with darker blue-green foliage shadows, cream highlights.
The artwork occupies the central 78% of the canvas with generous completely transparent padding; every pixel beyond the grassy/tree/building silhouette has zero alpha. Hard pixel-stepped outside contour; preserve alpha. No opaque box, no circular badge background, no frame, no fake checkerboard, no text, no lettering, no UI, no shadow outside the silhouette, no watermark, no ground slab, no 3D rendering, no blur or painted soft shading, no enormous city. Do not include Pokémon or trainers; reusable environment avatar.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Hearth Town regional terrain section for composing the larger Hearthvale world map.
Input image 1 is an ARCHITECTURE, PALETTE AND GEOGRAPHY REFERENCE of the close-up Hearth Town exploration map. Generate a NEW map at a much farther zoom level, not the same image and not a menu icon.
Primary request: a beautiful GBA-style top-down pixel-art WORLD-MAP TERRAIN TILE, square 1024x1024 full-bleed opaque terrain, north up, with tiny Hearth Town among broad gentle grassland and clumps of forest. This is one modular region segment of a larger continuous land map. Orthographic RPG perspective; hard crisp chunky pixels with controlled texture, limited clean colors, same spring green grass, dark leafy shadows, sand-yellow paths, terracotta roofs and teal lab as reference.
Scale and layout: the tiny four-building town takes ONLY about 25% of total canvas width near x50%, y68%. Exactly four miniature buildings around one small village clearing: red-roof cottage northwest, red-roof Center northeast, second red-roof cottage southwest, teal-roof lab southeast, a tiny central stone well. Low fence hints and flower dots. Each cottage roughly 4–5% of canvas width. One miniature tall-grass patch immediately west of town, another east. Match the reference town's relative landmark layout.
A single cream country road leads from the town north, winding gently through wide OPEN wildflower meadows, and reaches the top edge at x50%. At the top edge its final segment is vertical, centered with road width 6.25% of the image. There are no other road connections. Northern third is mostly sunny meadow with a few rounded trees, low shrubs and small patches of long grass, ready to connect to Route 1. Soft rolling lowland topography, no cliffs. Irregular mixed broadleaf tree groves hug the east, west and south of the town; keep town clearly visible. Bottom quarter is grassy ground and round tree clumps. The east, west and south image edges are ordinary grass/forest terrain ready for extension, not a decorative border. No enclosing rectangular tree wall.
This is inland lowland terrain, not an island or floating diorama: NO coast, NO ocean, NO water, NO exposed soil sides, NO white or transparent margins, NO framing. Map environment ONLY; characters and Pokémon supplied as separate sprites at runtime. No text, no labels, no numbers, no pins, no routes drawn as UI lines, no circles, no compass, no legend, no grid, no logo, no watermark.
Make the distinction between map scales unmistakable: broad countryside, very tiny four-building town, airy meadows, clearly readable route north.
